lines.rookie:
PIA'S STORY:
On Thursday night, I closed my stall at 11:30.
A big man walked past with a heavy box.
He came from the road to the museum.
He wore a yellow helmet.
On the helmet was a picture of a tall machine.
It lifts heavy things up high.

MY GRANDSON'S TOY BOX:
TRAIN — it runs on tracks.
CRANE — it lifts heavy things up high.
BOAT — it floats on water.
